broker_profile.py._no_sockets: Build the base analysis syscall filter without socket creation; execution-domain and mount checks remain separate controls.
broker_profile.py.AnalysisCapsule.__init__: Retain the admitted workspace, analysis payload and startup-info descriptor until gated spawn; construction mounts or launches nothing.
broker_profile.py.AnalysisCapsule._program: Describe isolated, site-free Python execution of the admitted analysis payload without invoking a shell.
broker_profile.py.AnalysisCapsule._mounts: Declare no additional host assets for the base analysis view beyond its fixed runtime and pinned workspace mounts.
broker_profile.py.AnalysisCapsule._network: Keep the base capsule's private network namespace instead of sharing the host network.
broker_profile.py.AnalysisCapsule._filter: Select the base no-socket syscall policy independently of the capsule's filesystem view.
broker_profile.py.AnalysisCapsule.__exit__: Release pinned asset, workspace and filter descriptors after launch setup; process retirement belongs to the broker.
broker_profile.py.CodexAsset._read: Verify a bounded trusted executable through its open descriptor and fingerprint unchanged bytes and physical identity; this manifest grants no execution authority.
broker_profile.py.CodexAsset.inspect: Resolve and inspect a host-selected executable without running it, closing the temporary descriptor after hashing.
broker_profile.py.NativeCapsule._mounts: Expose verified native assets, optional separate private state and sealed public network inputs without mounting host credentials or source-owned trust files.
broker_profile.py.NativeCapsule._network: Select host-network sharing for the direct native transport profile; this setting does not restrict destination hosts.
broker_profile.py.NativeCapsule._filter: Select the direct native Internet-client syscall profile while retaining kernel control denials; routing policy is a separate layer.
broker_profile.py.NativeCapsule.__enter__: Pin the native launch view and explicitly selected state/assets, then expose only its required descriptors and fixed runtime environment.
broker_profile.py.NativeCommandCapsule._network: Keep account-free command execution in its private network namespace rather than the native transport's host network.
broker_profile.py.NativeCommandCapsule._filter: Deny socket creation except private pairs and protect peer process controls for the dedicated command profile.
broker_profile.py.NativeProxyCapsule._network: Keep the native relay and child inside a private network namespace; host connectivity uses the separately owned descriptor channel.
broker_profile.py.NativeProxyCapsule._filter: Permit proxy listener/client sockets within the private namespace while denying protected peer and kernel controls; destination checks are not encoded here.
broker_profile.py.NativeProxyCapsule._program: Wrap the fixed native invocation with the sealed relay entry point and a duplicated child channel descriptor.
broker_profile.py.NativeProxyCapsule._mounts: Seal the trusted relay and stricter native-child filter into read-only mounts alongside the verified native assets.
broker_profile.py.NativeProxyCapsule.__enter__: Pin the relay/filter descriptors for one gated launch; entering the capsule does not release the process.
broker_profile.py.KenCapsule.__init__: Retain the inspected Ken installation, workspace identity and selected worker mode/cache without starting an MCP process.
broker_profile.py.KenCapsule.__enter__: Reuse the Ken worker launch with the pinned workspace, add the broker exec gate and syscall restrictions, and retain all descriptors until spawn.
broker_profile.py.KenCapsule.__exit__: Release this Ken launch description's retained resources; closing them alone is not proof that an MCP actor terminated.

broker_stdio.py._WriteProtocol: Translate pipe backpressure and connection loss into an event that lets writers distinguish writable transport from a failed connection.
broker_stdio.py._WriteProtocol.__init__: Begin with writable transport state and no observed connection error.
broker_stdio.py._WriteProtocol.pause_writing: Pause drain observers until the event loop reports that transport buffering is writable again.
broker_stdio.py._WriteProtocol.resume_writing: Wake drain observers after transport backpressure subsides.
broker_stdio.py._WriteProtocol.connection_lost: Retain a connection error and wake blocked writers instead of letting a closed input appear writable.
broker_stdio.py._PipeWriter: Adapt the event-loop write transport to the bounded RPC writer interface without becoming a second process owner.
broker_stdio.py._PipeWriter.__init__: Bind the existing pipe transport to its backpressure/error protocol.
broker_stdio.py._PipeWriter.write: Reject an already failed input before handing bytes to the event-loop transport; buffering is not peer acknowledgement.
broker_stdio.py._PipeWriter.drain: Yield for immediate connection errors, wait for writability and expose transport loss before reporting a completed drain.
broker_stdio.py._PipeWriter.close: Abort the write transport so a pending writer cannot retain a descriptor registration after owner cleanup.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker.__init__: Configure separate bounded launch, peer-close and whole-attempt Stop executors around the original broker without launching actors.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker.__aenter__: Enter one async ownership scope and reject reopening after entry or withdrawal.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker.__aexit__: Drain the original broker retirement when its async scope exits.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker.peer: Describe one analysis endpoint while leaving reservation, spawning and gate release to the original broker.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker.command: Describe an account-free command endpoint using the selected executable; no command payload is released by this factory.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker.ken: Describe a Ken endpoint with its selected installation/cache/mode, deferring actual preparation and launch to the broker.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker._close_peer: Close the original operation through the reserved peer-control worker and project its receipt afterward; whole-attempt shutdown keeps its existing owner.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker._shutdown: Coordinate revocation, constructor draining, unused transport cleanup and later SQL closure projection; retries concern closure, never payload execution.
broker_stdio.py.BrokerEndpoint._shutdown: Close this endpoint's data pipes and ask its original operation owner for physical closure when a launch identity exists.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker._start.observed: Remove a settled constructor future from pending accounting and consume its exception without replaying the launch.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker._start.discard: Close unreachable transport handles after a successful birth whose observer was cancelled; physical retirement stays with the original broker.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker._close_peer.close: Obtain the physical closure receipt before projecting the same original operation into local SQL.
broker_stdio.py.AsyncPeerBroker._close_peer.observed: Remove a completed peer-control future and consume its exception without creating a new closure owner.

broker_mcp.py._Pipes: Bridge one broker-owned endpoint to bounded MCP SDK channels, retaining physical shutdown ownership outside the SDK.
broker_mcp.py._Pipes.__init__: Create bounded read/write channels and bookkeeping for one endpoint without opening or spawning a process.
broker_mcp.py._Pipes.open: Open the existing endpoint owner once and start MCP input, output and diagnostic consumers.
broker_mcp.py._Pipes.fail: Wake SDK requests with connection loss and share one shielded peer close; raw decoder or validation details are not forwarded to SDK logs.
broker_mcp.py._Pipes._reader: Validate bounded newline-delimited typed MCP frames before forwarding them, ending the peer on malformed or incomplete input.
broker_mcp.py._Pipes._writer: Send bounded serialized SDK frames under the request deadline; write failure closes the existing peer instead of replaying an uncertain request.
broker_mcp.py._Pipes._stderr: Drain diagnostic bytes in fixed chunks without retaining an unbounded transcript or logging raw peer input.
broker_mcp.py._Pipes.close: Request physical peer closure before cancelling protocol tasks and releasing memory streams; unresolved closure errors remain visible.
broker_mcp.py._Client: Expose a bounded SDK session over the original broker peer, preserving uncertain delivery and avoiding automatic tool replay.
broker_mcp.py._Client.__init__: Bind the existing SDK session and pipe owner with zero local requests in flight.
broker_mcp.py._Client._run: Bound concurrent requests and duration, close the peer after an uncertain operation or cancellation, and sanitize transport failures without replay.
broker_mcp.py._Client.list_tools: Inspect tools over the already owned SDK session using its original continuation cursor and request limits.
broker_mcp.py._Client.call_tool: Invoke one tool through the original session; typed tool error results remain results, while transport uncertainty is handled separately.

peer_broker.py._digest: Fingerprint finite deterministic JSON for the broker's durable operation identity without treating a matching hash as authority.
peer_broker.py.PeerStart: Return a broker operation's state and freshness, with new transport handles only for a fresh successful gated birth.
peer_broker.py.PeerTransport.wait: Observe the original owner's direct-child exit without transferring pidfd/reaping ownership or certifying domain retirement.
peer_broker.py.PeerTransport.close_handles: Release only the client's duplicate data streams; the broker retains process and subtree supervision.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker._grant_key.getter: Locate this broker concession's journal record without creating a grant or changing its state.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker._update: Publish an operation-state change only while the same original owner and global concession remain active, using a witnessed compare-and-swap.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker._info: Read a bounded startup-info object before its deadline; parsing the object is not itself validation or release of the reported namespace.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker.run_peer: Request one analysis peer through the common reserve/spawn/bind/release path, preserving its original operation key.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker.run_ken: Require an inspected Ken installation, fixed worker mode and needed model cache before entering the shared owned launch path.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker.run_command: Require an inspected native executable and select the account-free command profile under the common broker ownership protocol.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker._physical: Retire the original attempt subtree once under its physical lock and recover that exact closure receipt on later calls.
peer_broker.py.PeerBroker._require_dead_owner: Reject recovery while the visible original PID/start-tick owner is alive; missing visibility stays uncertain and a reused PID is not the original owner.
